profile.goodFor: pitch correction for vocals: gentle tightening, or a hard robotic effect with a fast retune speed

settings.name: Key
settings.what: the song's key the notes are corrected to

settings.name: Scale
settings.what: which notes of the key are allowed; chromatic allows all 12

settings.name: Retune speed
settings.what: how fast a note is pulled to pitch: slow is natural, Robot is the hard effect

settings.name: Humanize
settings.what: leaves long notes a little freer so they sound less processed

settings.name: Formants
settings.what: keeps the voice's character when the pitch moves, or lets it follow
